item.title: Clerk: fee-start (2027-01-01)
item.description: Clerk Directory Sync connection billing starts 2027-01-01 (same ladder as SSO: 1 included on Pro/Business, then $75 / $60 bands). Announced on clerk.com/pricing.

item.title: AuthCost: coverage-added (2026-11-07)
item.description: Added Authagonal (Free 250 MAU hard cap with unlimited SSO+SCIM; Starter $29/1k hard cap; Pro $69/5k then $0.04; Scale $149/25k then $0.025; Enterprise $339/100k+ then $0.015 — 50k scenarios select Enterprise at $339 per vendor blog; no Mid tier for 25k–100k) as a full ledger vendor. Read from authagonal.io/pricing on 2026-11-07. Yearly = Save 1 month (11× monthly). Now ranks in the calculator and on /guides/enterprise-sso-cost (no longer unread / reference-only).

item.title: AuthCost: coverage-added (2026-11-07)
item.description: Added Scalekit (Free 25k MAU / 1 SSO+1 SCIM; Growth $99 + $60/$45/$35/$30 connection ladder, first of each free) and SSOJet (Free unlimited users no SSO; Business monthly $79/$72/$65/$55/$47 per shared SSO-or-SCIM connection) as full ledger vendors. Read from scalekit.com/pricing/auth-for-saas and ssojet.com/pricing on 2026-11-07. They now rank in the calculator and on /guides/enterprise-sso-cost (no longer reference-only / unread).

item.title: AuthCost: correction (2026-10-31)
item.description: Addition/correction: SCIM / Directory Sync is now priced, from each vendor's pricing page read 2026-10-31. WorkOS bills Directory Sync as its own connection ($125 each for 1–15, then $100/$80/$65), so a customer on SSO and SCIM is two connections; Clerk includes 1 Directory Sync connection, then $75/mo each (2–15), $60, $48, billed from January 1, 2027; Stytch's 5 included connections are shared between SSO and SCIM, then $125 each; Auth0 includes inbound SCIM on Free and B2B plans; Descope includes SCIM on Growth; Kinde lists SCIM as coming soon on Scale; Cognito, Supabase, Firebase / Identity Platform and Logto publish no SCIM on their pricing pages. Before, SCIM was listed per plan but never added to totals: at 10k users with 3 SSO customers who all need SCIM, WorkOS read $375/mo and is $750/mo; Stytch read $0 and is $125/mo; Clerk Pro read $275/mo and is $425/mo from 2027-01-01. New calculator input scim= (default 0).

item.title: Auth0: coverage-added (2026-10-31)
item.description: Added Auth0 for Startups (auth0.com/startups, read 2026-10-31): eligible startups (venture-backed with less than $5M in funding, less than $1M ARR, less than two years from incorporation; not existing paid Auth0/Okta customers or past members) get one year of the B2B Professional plan free, up to 100,000 MAU with 5 Enterprise Connections and inbound SCIM. Shown as a note on the SSO guide, Auth0 vendor page and every Auth0 comparison with the month-13 list price (B2B Professional with 3 SSO connections: $800/mo at 1,000 MAU, $1,500 at 5,000, $2,400 at 10,000; above 10,000 MAU contact sales). Rankings still use list prices.

item.title: AuthCost: correction (2026-10-31)
item.description: Correction: SSO and B2B answers now include organization/tenant fees and caps read from vendor pages on 2026-10-31. Clerk: 100 monthly retained orgs and 20 members per org free; above either, the B2B Authentication add-on is $100/mo ($85 annual), then $1/mo per org (101–1,000), $0.90 (1,001–10,000), $0.75 (10,001–100,000), $0.60 (100,001+). Auth0: Free 5 and B2C plans 10 organizations; B2B unlimited. Descope: 10/35/100 active tenants, then $1 per tenant on Pro and Growth. Kinde: Free 5 orgs, paid 50 then $0.50/$0.47/$0.43. Logto: Organizations add-on $48/mo. Each SSO connection now counts as 1 customer organization. Before, Clerk vs Auth0 at 10k users with 1 SSO connection read '$300/yr less than Clerk'; it is $1,500/yr (Clerk Pro $125/mo incl. the $100/mo add-on for 200-member orgs).

item.title: AuthCost: coverage-added (2026-10-31)
item.description: Added Firebase Auth / Identity Platform (no cost to 50k MAU, then $0.0055→$0.0025/MAU bands; SAML/OIDC $0.015/MAU after 50) and Descope (Free 7.5k MAU; Pro from $249/mo with 10k MAU + $0.05/MAU; Growth from $799/mo with 25k MAU), read from their official pricing pages. New guide: what self-hosting Better Auth / Auth.js costs instead.

item.title: Clerk: new-tier (2026-10-31)
item.description: Clerk publishes a new enterprise SSO connection band: connections 101–250 now cost $48/mo each (was "Contact us" for 101+). Earlier bands are unchanged: 1 included, $75/mo each for 2–15, $60/mo each for 16–100; 251+ is contact sales.

item.title: Auth0: correction (2026-10-31)
item.description: Correction: our earlier Auth0 data (2026-10-30) listed paid tiers only at 500 MAU and called higher volumes and B2B “custom”. That was wrong — Auth0 publishes MAU tiers: B2C Essentials $70 (1k) to $3,500 (50k)/mo, B2C Professional to $3,200 (20k), B2B Essentials $150 (500) to $3,800 (20k) with 3 SSO connections, B2B Professional $800 to $2,400 (10k) with 5. Billing rounds up to the next tier; yearly = 11× monthly; extra SSO connections $100/mo. Not an Auth0 price change — our omission, now fixed.
